contracts.wall_opening: Resolve exactly one host wall before drawing. Cut only its solid outline and hatch from the same opening interval. Never guess an orphan host.
contracts.door: Use a shared host-face hinge, closed axis, swing side and radius. Validate the swept quarter-sector against solid walls, equipment and reserved voids.
contracts.window: Use the same hosted interval in plan and elevation. Reject overlapping openings and column/junction conflicts.
contracts.placement: Compare full footprints rather than only insertion points. Preserve declared room/equipment coordinates; report unresolved conflicts.
contracts.labels: Keep room labels in their declared or wall-derived local zone. Avoid walls, stair/elevator voids, fixtures and furniture. Block when no clear position exists.
contracts.connectivity: Check free-space reachability from a verified floor entrance through actual openings to supplied room points. This is not a legal egress check.
contracts.presentation: Keep views within their assigned frame and title-block zones. Review text overlap, clipping, font coverage and actual viewport scale.
contracts.delivery: One DWG, Model plus layouts; no PDF unless explicitly requested. File validity never overrides spatial errors.

manual_review: legacy drawings without semantic room/floor/opening IDs
